templates.name: Fisherman Hermit
lines: The nets have been coming up empty. Something greedy moved into the water.

templates.name: Gravedigger
lines: Midnight? That's when the bells stop.
Once I get my old name back, I can finally rest.
Who digs the grave for the gravedigger?
Who keeps checking an empty grave?

templates.name: Drunk
lines: Hic! What time it is? There ain't no bells anymore.

templates.name: Merchant
lines: Gold is easy to find. Secrets are harder. Care to trade?

fortHint.line: They say the old dwarven fort still holds a fortune. I've sold supplies to plenty who went looking. Few came back. Where is it? I will mark it on your map.

templates.name: Herbalist
lines: The forest is dangerous but holds many remedies, if you know where to look.

ancientBellLich.name: Ancient Lich
lines: The bell... I have not heard its sweet voice in a very long time. The world I knew is long gone. So much changed after the pillar rose. And my key... I can no longer feel its weight upon my neck.
